T33.note: counting basis differs from T32 (no recovered T33 C): of the vendor tx-isp-t33.ko (1571 functions) 1162 have a T32 namesake and run on the shared driver/t32 port; the bar counts the 409 T33-only functions; proven = 284 that pass the binary oracle (vendor instructions in Unicorn against our C, tests/t33_binoracle, openimp #99); 29 more are ported by name in the T33 files but not oracle-proven yet (QEMU apitest only); 62 are unreachable (no caller and no function-pointer reference in the vendor module, or only from such code: nothing to prove); the remaining 63 are reachable (tuning node, /proc, irq, AOV) and not proven, see openimp #589, #590, #524; not device-tested

T32.note: bit-exact against the recovered vendor C on the host; merged into open-tx-isp next; reference-C oracles stay on the T32 branch until upstream PR #15; host-proven, not device-tested; the 1591 counts every reference function a conf links (REFS); recount 2026-11-20 (open-tx-isp tests/t32_oracle/refs_audit.py, openimp #645): of 1574 distinct names 1287 are called by an oracle, 158 only named, 129 only linked as callees, real-body audit 2026-11-21 (open-tx-isp tests/t32_oracle/real_audit.py, T32 build): 1281 of the 1574 names are proven against a driver function with a real body, 7 weak (isp_info print helpers), 158 named-only, 128 callee-only (compared through their caller); 20 of 79 T32 API glue entry points are constant or store-only stubs (#716 BCSH / sharpness / fps, #717 ported but not wired, #289 deliberate)
